title: Kepler Cross-Staff Observation
description: Raw observation format for cross-staff surveys. Submission-ready physical quantities use the canonical units declared by this schema.

observed_at.description: Observation date or timestamp. Preserve the precision supported by the source record.

fiducial_width.description: Width of the crosspiece segment used to span the observed targets, in millimetres.

staff_reading.description: Position of the crosspiece measured from the instrument origin along the staff, in millimetres.

notes_id.description: Optional identifier linking to a separate narrative note.

calibration.description: Calibration reference geometry. Non-null only for calibration observations.

target_width.description: Known physical width of the calibration target, in millimetres.

target_distance.description: Distance to the calibration target as defined by the calibration protocol, in millimetres.

field_observation.description: Ordered target pair measured during a field observation. Non-null only for field observations.
